A rectangular piece of paper $A B C D$ is $5 \mathrm{~cm}$ wide and $50 \mathrm{~cm}$ long. It is white on one side and grey on the other. The strip is first folded as shown so that vertex $B$ coincides with $M$, the midpoint of edge $C D$. It is then folded so that vertex $D$ coincides with $N$, the midpoint of edge $A B$. What is the area of the visible white part in the diagram?
Choices:
A:$50 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$60 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$62.5 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$100 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$125 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$

Four cogs are connected to each other as shown in the picture. The first has 30 teeth, the second 15, the third 60 and the fourth 10 . How many turns will the last cog make for each full turn of the first cog?

A journey is made one afternoon at constant speed. The clocks show the departure and arrival times.
In which position will the minute hand be when one third of the journey has been completed?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

Eight identical track pieces form the circle shown on the left. A second track begins with the 2 pieces shown on the right and is to be completed as a closed track using the smallest possible number of these pieces. How many pieces will the second track use in total?

The arrangement shown consists of square tiles of different sizes. The smallest tile has a perimeter of $80 \mathrm{~cm}$. What is the length of the path shown along the edges of the tiles?
Choices:
A:$380 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$400 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$420 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$440 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$1680 \mathrm{~cm}$

In the picture there is a square tile with two fourths of a circle. The radius of every fourth is half the side of the tile and its length equals $5 \mathrm{dm}$. A large square is formed from 16 such tiles. What is the maximum possible length of an unbroken continuous curve consisting of the fourths?
Choices:
A:$75 \mathrm{dm}$
B:$100 \mathrm{dm}$
C:$105 \mathrm{dm}$
D:$110 \mathrm{dm}$
E:$80 \mathrm{dm}$

The rectangle $A B C D$ is made up of 12 congruent rectangles (see diagram). How big is the ratio $\frac{A D}{D C}$?
Choices:
A:$\frac{8}{9}$
B:$\frac{5}{6}$
C:$\frac{7}{8}$
D:$\frac{2}{3}$
E:$\frac{9}{8}$

A $3 \mathrm{~cm}$ wide strip is grey on one side and white on the other. The strip is folded so that it fits inside a rectangle of length $27 \mathrm{~cm}$, as shown. The grey trapeziums are identical. What is the length of the original strip?
Choices:
A:$36 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$48 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$54 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$57 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$81 \mathrm{~cm}$
A measuring tape is wrapped around a cylinder. Which number should be at the place shown by the question mark?
A measuring tape is wound around a cylinder. What number should be at the place shown by the question mark?

In a box-shaped water tank with dimensions $4 \mathrm{~m} \times 2 \mathrm{~m} \times 1 \mathrm{~m}$, the height of the water is $25 \mathrm{~cm}$. The tank is then turned on its side (see picture on the right). How high is the water in the tank now?
Choices:
A:$25 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$50 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$75 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$1 \mathrm{~m}$
E:$1.25 \mathrm{~m}$

The diagram shows a cube with edges of length $12 \mathrm{~cm}$. What is the length of the route shown from point $P$ to point $Q$?
Choices:
A:$40 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$48 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$50 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$60 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:more information is needed

Four cubes with edge lengths $1$, $2$, $3$, and $4$ are stacked as shown. What is the length of the portion of $\overline{XY}$ contained in the cube with edge length $3$?
Choices:
A:$\frac{3\sqrt{33}}5$
B:$2\sqrt{3}$
C:$\frac{2\sqrt{33}}3$
D:$4$
E:$3\sqrt{2} $

In the rectangular parallelepiped shown, $AB = 3, BC= 1,$ and $CG = 2$. Point $M$ is the midpoint of $\overline{FG}$. What is the volume of the rectangular pyramid with base $BCHE$ and apex $M$?

Choices:
A:$1$
B:$\frac{4}{3}$
C:$\frac{3}{2}$
D:$\frac{5}{3}$
E:$2$

A unit cube is cut twice to form three triangular prisms, two of which are congruent, as shown in Figure 1. The cube is then cut in the same manner along the dashed lines shown in Figure 2. This creates nine pieces. What is the volume of the piece that contains vertex $ W$?
Choices:
A:$\frac{1}{12}$
B:$\frac{1}{9}$
C:$\frac{1}{8}$
D:$\frac{1}{6}$
E:$\frac{1}{4}$

In the cube $ABCDEFGH$ with opposite vertices $C$ and $E,$ $J$ and $I$ are the midpoints of edges $\overline{FB}$ and $\overline{HD},$ respectively. Let $R$ be the ratio of the area of the cross-section $EJCI$ to the area of one of the faces of the cube. What is $R^2?$

Choices:
A:$\frac{5}{4}$
B:$\frac{4}{3}$
C:$\frac{3}{2}$
D:$\frac{25}{16}$
E:$\frac{9}{4}$
